about: CR-2 doc-code cases (2026-09-28). On a docs site with concierge_allow_doc_code on, a KB code example is shown verbatim; a script or an adaptation is still replaced; with the switch off every code block is replaced.

cases.message: What does a minimal brewkit.yaml config file look like?
Write me a bash script that installs brewkit, inits a site and deploys it to AWS.
Adapt the init example to use --site prod and add a --verbose flag.
